annotations.title: User journeys and where people get stuck

description: Where do people get stuck in the app, and what should change? Reads the Journey optimizer for one project: page-to-page moves from real visits over the last days (7, 30 default, or 90) joined with the latest site scan's links. Returns { days, liveUrl, score (0-100, 100 = no findings), rootPath, stats: { sessions, pageViews, pages, avgPagesPerSession, bounceRate, sampled }, scan, mapScan, recording ({ until, sampleRate } of the on-demand visit recording; until null = off), flows (top 10 common paths), findingsTotal, findingsByKind, findings: [{ id, kind, severity, pages, title, detail, suggestion, prompt }], next }. Kinds: broken, dead_end, high_exit, loop, reload, duplicate_page, route_variant, duplicate_title, orphan, deep_page, unvisited. Each finding's prompt is a ready instruction for a coding agent in the app's repo. Optional kind filters the findings, limit caps them (default 20, max 100), includeGraph adds the page nodes and edges (large). Read-only. With no scan yet, call scan_site_journeys first; for event-level funnels use query_funnel or get_user_paths.

includeGraph.description: Also return the page nodes and page-to-page edges (up to 60 and 160 rows)

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)
